# Single source of truth for the wire format, the style structs and themes.
# Run `go run ./tools/gen` after editing; `go run ./tools/gen -check` fails
# when a generated file is stale.

# op <Name> <code> [field:type ...] [+flag ...] [native=custom|skip] [web=custom|skip] ["doc"]
#
# Fields are the payload in order. Unless a backend is marked, both decoders
# are generated: the engine stores each field in the node under its name
# (src/node.gen.hpp) and web/qui.js under its camelCase name. `+flag` also sets
# a bool field, `+flag@native` only in the engine. `custom` leaves the op to
# hand-written code in src/engine.cpp or web/qui.js; `skip` reads and drops
# the payload, for ops a backend ignores. Field types: u8 u16 u32 i32 u64 f32
# bool (a u8) str (u32 length, then UTF-8) f32x4; `=v` sets the engine default.
# Indented lines continue the doc.

op End 0 native=custom web=custom "Closes the open node."
op Open 1 kind:u8 id:u64 native=custom web=custom "Opens a node; its property ops, children and `End` follow."
op Frame 2 version:u8 theme:u8 native=custom web=custom "Starts the stream."
op Palette 45 count:u16 entries:token_rgba native=custom web=custom
  "Optional, directly after `Frame`: `count` pairs of `token:u8 rgba:u32` that
  override or add theme tokens for this frame. Ids 20 to 255 are free for apps
  and show up on the web as `--qui-T<id>`."
op ImageData 46 key:u64 w:u16 h:u16 pixels:rgba native=custom web=custom
  "`w*h*4` bytes of straight RGBA. Sent once per key, directly after `Palette`,
  and the engine keeps it."
op ImageShared 66 key:u64 token:u64 native=custom web=skip
  "Like `ImageData`, but the pixels were lent to the engine out of band under
  `token` (`qui_stage_image`) and are shared rather than carried in the stream."
op SvgData 57 key:u64 svg:str native=custom web=custom
  "SVG text, sent once per key directly after `Palette` like `ImageData`, and
  the engine keeps it. `Icon` nodes draw it fitted to their box in their `Fg`
  (`Ink` when unset), using only the shapes' coverage."
op ImageFree 52 key:u64 native=custom web=custom
  "Directly after `Palette` like `ImageData`: forgets the image and its atlas
  space."

op Dir 3 dir:u8 "`Column` 0, `Row` 1 or `Stack` 2."
op Width 4 w_mode:u8 w_val:f32 "A size: `Fit` 0, `Fill` 1 (the value is the weight), `Px` 2, `Pct` 3."
op Height 5 h_mode:u8 h_val:f32 "Like `Width`."
op MinW 6 min_w:f32
op MaxW 7 max_w:f32
op MinH 8 min_h:f32
op MaxH 9 max_h:f32
op Pad 10 pad:f32x4 "Top, right, bottom, left."
op Gap 11 gap:f32
op Align 12 align:u8 "Cross axis: `Start Center End Stretch`."
op Justify 13 justify:u8 "Main axis: `Start Center End Between`; on text, the line alignment."
op Pos 14 pos_x:f32 pos_y:f32 +has_pos "Places the box at x, y in its parent, out of the flow."
op Fixed 64 +fixed +has_pos
  "With `Pos`, the box is placed in window coordinates instead of its
  parent's; `Fill` takes the window's size, and the parent's clip and scroll do
  not apply."
op Z 39 z:i32 "Paint and hit order among siblings; ties keep tree order."
op Bg 15 bg:u32 "A color is `0xRRGGBBAA`; a theme token is `token << 24` with the low 24 bits clear."
op Fg 16 fg:u32
op Border 17 border:u32 border_w:f32
op Radius 18 radius:f32
op Opacity 19 opacity:f32=1
op Gradient 40 gradient_from:u32 gradient_to:u32 gradient_angle:f32 +has_gradient
  "CSS degrees; fills a box, or colors the glyphs of a `Text`."
op Shadow 41 shadow:u32 shadow_blur:f32 shadow_y:f32 "Painted outside the box only."
op Clip 20 +clip
op Scroll 21 +scroll +clip@native "Scrolls vertically; needs a bounded height."
op NoScrollbar 65 +no_scrollbar
  "A `Scroll` box or `Virtual` list scrolls without drawing a scrollbar or
  taking scrollbar drags. On the web it is `scrollbar-width: none`."
op ScrollTo 43 scroll_to:f32 +has_scroll_to "Sets the scroll offset of a `Scroll` box this frame."
op Hit 22 hit:u8 "Reports pointer input for the box."
op Select 54 +select native=custom
  "Starts a selection root, so a mouse selection that begins inside stays
  inside. The frame root is one, so all text is selectable unless turned off."
op NoSelect 59 +no_select native=custom
  "No text selection in this subtree until a `Select` below. Boxes with role
  `Button`, `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `Switch` or `Slider` behave as if they had it,
  and it wins over `Select` on the same box."
op Ease 60 ease:f32
  "Milliseconds: changes to `Bg`, `Fg`, `Border`, `Radius`, `Opacity` and the
  button hover tint animate (ease-out cubic) instead of jumping. State is kept
  per node id; a node absent for a frame starts fresh. On the web it is a CSS
  `transition`."
op HoverBg 61 hover_bg:u32
  "The background while the pointer is over this box or any hit inside it, in
  place of a button's hover tint. On the web it is `:hover`."
op Drag 63 +drag web=skip
  "A press on this box, outside the hit boxes inside it, moves the window.
  Native desktop only; it is for windows opened borderless
  (`qui_set_borderless`)."
op Wrap 55 +wrap "On a `Row`: flows children onto new lines."
op Gestures 44 gestures:u8 "Mask of `PanX`, `PanY`, `Pinch` and `TouchOnly`."
op Role 23 role:u8 native=custom
  "On the web it picks the element. `Button` on a `Hit` box: takes focus,
  clicks on Enter and Space, gets the hover and press tints like a `Button`
  node, and is role=button on the web."
op Label 24 label:str "The accessible name."
op Key 67 key_name:str web=skip
  "The key the node was opened with. Sent only when bit 0 of the results
  header's `debug` field is set, as offscreen runs do, so `QUI_TREE` and
  `QUI_DRIVE` selectors can name nodes."
op Value 56 value:f32 native=skip
  "The state of a `Switch` (0 or 1) or `Slider` (0 to 1) box, for assistive
  tech."

op Text 25 text:str web=custom
op Span 49 start:u32 end:u32 flags:u8 fg:u32 bg:u32 id:u64 image:u64 native=custom web=custom
  "After `Text`. Styles a byte range; `id` non-zero makes it a hit target
  reported under that id. `flags`: `Bold` 1, `Mono` 2, `Italic` 4, `Underline`
  8, `Strike` 16, `HoverUnderline` 64 (underlines only while the span is
  hovered or pressed), `Image` 32 (draws the loaded image `image` over the
  span's placeholder text)."
op FontSize 26 font_size:f32
op Weight 27 weight:u8 "1 for bold."
op Mono 28 +mono
op Ellipsis 29 +ellipsis
op Tracking 42 tracking:f32 "Extra advance per letter in logical px; turns ligatures off when nonzero."

op Virtual 30 count:u32 est:f32 bottom:bool "Makes a `List` virtual: item count, estimated row height, and whether it starts at the bottom."
op Item 31 item:u32 native=custom "The index of a list row."
op Prepend 50 prepend:u32 web=skip
  "On a `List`: items inserted at the front this frame; the engine shifts its
  scroll anchor and cached heights by that count."
op Jump 51 jump:u32 +has_jump web=skip "On a `List`: scrolls that item to the top on this frame only."
op Glide 62 +glide web=skip
  "With `Jump`: eases the item to the middle of the viewport over the next
  frames instead, cutting to a screen away first when it is far; user
  scrolling cancels it."

op Src 32 src:str "Shader source."
op Uniform 33 name:str8 count:u8 values:f32xN native=custom web=custom
op Fps 34 fps:f32

op Placeholder 35 placeholder:str
op Multiline 36 multiline:u8 native=custom "1 for Enter inserting a newline, 2 for Enter submitting."
op Password 37 +password
op PassthroughNav 53 +passthrough_nav "Hands Up, Down and Tab to the app instead of the field."
op Bare 58 +bare native=custom
  "On an `Input` directly after `Open`: clears its default background and
  border, so a focused field shows no accent border."
op Focus 38 focus_mode:u8 native=custom "1 to focus on first appearance, 2 to focus now."

op Img 47 image:u64 web=custom "The image an `Image` node shows, or the SVG an `Icon` node shows."
op Fit 48 fit:u8 "`Cover` 0, `Contain` 1, `Stretch` 2, plus `Pixelated` 16 or `Bicubic` 32."

# style <Struct> <field> <type> [Op] [go=Name] ["doc"]
#
# The fields of Style and TextStyle in C++ declaration order, which is public
# API because designated initializers must follow it. Types: class key size
# f32 edges align pos part i32 color border gradient shadow flag on optf32
# gestures role string motion. `flag` sends the op alone, `on` sends it with a
# 1, `pos` sends `Pos` with the following `x` and `y` parts when set or when
# `fixed` is, `border` sends its color with the `<name>_w` part (1 when 0), and
# `motion` is an f32 that `reduce_motion` drops. Classes fill fields left at
# zero and OR the bools.

style Style klass class go=Class "Class names registered with define_class (Go Ui.Class), separated by spaces."
style Style w size Width
style Style h size Height
style Style min_w f32 MinW
style Style max_w f32 MaxW
style Style min_h f32 MinH
style Style max_h f32 MaxH
style Style pad edges Pad
style Style gap f32 Gap
style Style align align Align
style Style justify align Justify
style Style absolute pos Pos
style Style x part
style Style y part
style Style z i32 Z
style Style bg color Bg
style Style fg color Fg
style Style border border Border
style Style border_w part
style Style radius f32 Radius
style Style opacity f32 Opacity
style Style gradient gradient Gradient
style Style shadow shadow Shadow
style Style clip flag Clip
style Style scroll flag Scroll
style Style hit on Hit
style Style scroll_to optf32 ScrollTo
style Style gestures gestures Gestures
style Style role role Role
style Style label string Label
style Style key key
style Style select flag Select
style Style wrap flag Wrap
style Style no_select flag NoSelect
  "Keeps the mouse from selecting text in this subtree; select on a descendant
  turns it back on there."
style Style ease motion Ease
  "Animates changes to bg, fg, border, radius, opacity and the hover tint of
  buttons over this many milliseconds."
style Style hover_bg color HoverBg
  "Replaces bg while the pointer is over the box or anything in it, without
  waiting a frame."
style Style drag flag Drag
  "Moves the window when pressed outside the hit boxes inside it, as a title
  bar does. Native desktop only; see set_borderless."
style Style fixed flag Fixed
  "Positions the box at x, y in window coordinates, as CSS position: fixed
  does. Fill sizes take the window's size, and the parent's clip and scroll do
  not apply."
style Style no_scrollbar flag NoScrollbar
  "Scrolls without drawing a scrollbar; the wheel, touch and keys still work."

style TextStyle klass class go=Class "Class names registered with define_text_class (Go Ui.TextClass), separated by spaces."

style TextStyle bold on Weight
style TextStyle mono flag Mono
style TextStyle ellipsis flag Ellipsis
style TextStyle color color Fg
style TextStyle w size Width
style TextStyle align align Justify

style TextStyle tracking f32 Tracking
